quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year to March 2026 (annual securities report, IFRS; amounts in JPY hundred million as the report states them): revenue 139,952 (prior year 146,626); gross profit 13,282 (12,884); share of profit of equity-method investments 4,474 (4,941); profit for the year attributable to owners of the parent 8,340 (9,003); core operating cash flow 9,789 (10,275). Profit attributable by operating segment: Mineral & Metal Resources 2,536 (2,854), Energy 1,642 (1,735), Machinery & Infrastructure 2,259 (2,329), Chemicals 675 (759), Iron & Steel Products 189 (132), Lifestyle 520 (537), Innovation & Corporate Development 590 (873). Equity production: iron ore 63.8 million tonnes (including 22.5 million tonnes attributable to its Vale interest); oil and gas 211 thousand barrels a day.

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui & Co. annual securities report: FY2026 (06-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 (amounts in JPY hundred million): profit attributable to owners of the parent 9,200 (up 860 from 8,340), core operating cash flow 10,500, gross profit 14,500, share of profit of equity-method investments 5,200, assuming JPY 150.00/USD and JCC crude at US$84/bbl; by segment, profit attributable Mineral & Metal Resources 2,500, Energy 2,000, Mobility, Digital & Infrastructure 2,400, Chemicals 750, Wellness Ecosystem 550, Innovation & Corporate Development 700. Medium-term Management Plan 2029 (May 2026) targets for the year to March 2029: core operating cash flow JPY 1.2 trillion, profit attributable JPY 1.1 trillion and ROE 12%; for 2030 it aims at profit attributable above JPY 1.4 trillion and ROE above 13%. Under 'Global Energy Transformation 2.0' the plan extends the energy business to the value chain from supplying computing power to its use, besides optimal energy supply.
quarterly_data.figure: FY to March 2027 forecast: profit attributable JPY 9,200 hundred million; MTP 2029: profit JPY 1.1 trillion, core operating cash flow JPY 1.2 trillion (FY to March 2029)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui & Co. annual securities report: FY2026 (06-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Investments (annual securities report): investments and loans in the year to March 2026 were about JPY 1.38 trillion, led by the Rhodes Ridge iron ore project (Mineral & Metal Resources) and oil and gas production projects (Energy); main property, plant and equipment spending: Rhodes Ridge iron ore JPY 7,238 hundred million, Australian iron ore JPY 663 hundred million, Australian coking coal JPY 215 hundred million, oil and gas development and production JPY 1,271 hundred million, power generation JPY 425 hundred million, chemical tank terminals JPY 184 hundred million. Under MTP 2026 it executed about JPY 2.4 trillion of growth investment including the Rhodes Ridge interest, and it says future capex will stay centred on Mineral & Metal Resources and Energy. Mitsui E&P Middle East's oil and gas production interests in Oman are being sold, subject to regulatory approvals. ITC Antwerp became a consolidated subsidiary from Q2; the Innovation & Corporate Development segment booked FVTPL-related gains from Quantinuum, and JA Mitsui Leasing's US factoring business caused an equity-method loss of JPY 604 hundred million linked to receivables acquired from First Brands Group.
quarterly_data.figure: investments and loans ~JPY 1.38 trillion; Rhodes Ridge PP&E spending JPY 7,238 hundred million
